from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfit(BaseModel):
    """One company's total profit from a financial report period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as written in the report")
    total_profit: float | None = Field(description="The total profit (利润总额) amount reported")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this profit figure")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Securities/code number if available in the report")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line or excerpt containing the total profit figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profits: list[CompanyProfit]
